answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity. Every agent locks a bond in the network token, yarrow, and its voting weight equals its stake, not its account count. An attacker can spawn countless mirror accounts for free, but their weights still sum to the same bond, so splitting never amplifies influence. To outweigh honest agents they must lock more yarrow than everyone else combined, and any detected fraud slashes that bond. Over a long horizon the cost of a Sybil attempt is the entire seized stake, while honest participants keep theirs.
